action.objective: Commit verified Rxb6, winning the b6 pawn with the rook on an active file
action.rationale: f6b6 is the only commit_ready move: depth-3 exact score -700, safety.complete (all immediate Black mates checked), tactical_refutation not_found, and no forced recapture shown. It wins the b6 pawn and centralizes the rook. The evaluation is objectively losing (-700), but it is the best verified move; alternatives were upper-bound only. Note: h7h4 Qxh4+ is a legal immediate capture of the h4 pawn, so the position remains difficult, but Rxb6 is the strongest verified option.
